$comment: Models and labs that have a readable vendor price page but are not in the catalog yet because the automated price feed (LiteLLM) does not carry them. The catalog's rule is to wait for the feed rather than hand-add a price that nothing can correct (see `$coverage` in pricing-overrides.json). This file is what turns 'wait' from a hope into a check: scripts/watch-later-additions.ts runs weekly and opens one issue the week the feed starts carrying any of them. `feedKey` is a regular expression over the feed's own keys, anchored on the vendor's own prefix so a copy hosted by somebody else (tencent/glm-5.3-flashx, novita/stepfun/..., writer.palmyra-* on Bedrock) never counts. Once an item reaches the catalog the watcher stops listing it. Prices in `note` were read on the date given and are leads, not records: adding one still means reading the page again.
